problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $X,$ given by

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 5 & -1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 & -2 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{1}$ on $X?$

examples.knowledge_point: Applying Row Operations To an Augmented Matrix
examples.problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $A,$ given by

$$
\begin{aligned}-1 & 5 & 4 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 5 & 2 \\ 3 & 7 & 1 & 9\end{aligned}
$$

 

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation $R_1 \leftrightarrow R_2$ on $A?$
examples.worked_solution:
The operation $R_1 \leftrightarrow R_2$ means that we need to swap the first and second rows.

Applying this row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 5 & 4 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 5 & 2 \\ 3 & 7 & 1 & 9\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{1}↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 5 & 2 \\ -1 & 5 & 4 & 1 \\ 3 & 7 & 1 & 9\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

feedback.problem:
Consider the matrix $A,$ given by

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}7 & 4 & -1 \\ 1 & 5 & -3 \\ 0 & 5 & -2\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{1}↔{R}_{2}$ on $A?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The operation ${R}_{1}↔{R}_{2}$ means that we need to swap the first and second rows.

Applying this row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}7 & 4 & -1 \\ 1 & 5 & -3 \\ 0 & 5 & -2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 & -3 \\ 7 & 4 & -1 \\ 0 & 5 & -2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
